Owner-authorized follow-through, 15 October 2026. Tag: reality-check-20261015.
Assessed baseline: 13aec7cc874ed1c2695c6dd281852523cc43ef90; clean local/GitHub main; exact-head CI 38757201426 passed 15,474 tests, zero failures/errors and 44 optional skips. Documentation is deployed. Constructor and supported-boundary repairs are completed prerequisites, not a new queue.

Decision: grakern remains pinned to GitHub for now. Retain default 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841 and its transitive source pins until a reviewed reason changes them. Immediate delivery is a reproducible source build plus offline JVM CLI. Full Maven publication of artifacts depending on unpublished grakern remains deferred and cannot be inferred from source builds or bundled JARs. This changes the execution order, not the existing platform or scientific guarantees.

Four workstreams and acceptance:
1. S1 bd-01M50K8E8KMRGY0MYXJRT0SZ8G: qualify a fresh, no-override GitHub source build; manifest-verify the CLI and offline public replay; explicitly inventory deferred Maven closure. Existing infrastructure bd-01M2TAKTB61XNXV4Y6A9J3CB0C retains eventual publication/signing/baseline obligations.
2. N1 bd-01M4YP83C7925M22V0K5AQ88BX: deliver and select an accepted corrected Native runtime, then qualify the exact producer and pinned consumer. Reuse reviewed patch c3d9136408a18515e51a36561c24feeb595fc44f and its original/fixed evidence. Prepare the upstream contribution/release route; a fork or reduced platform promise needs a separate explicit owner decision. Keep the gate open until the selected artifact is independently fetchable and StoryModel uses it. Run the named zero-hash controls and complete String suite across Linux/macOS and debug/release-fast as applicable, plus producer/consumer gates; skip/fixture workarounds cannot close this prerequisite.
3. Own-study local analysis: U1 bd-01M50K95JAQB34R876FWMV85J0 defines the admission contract/ADR; U2 bd-01M50K9WYM4TQSX106M7Q2YAF4 implements it; U3 bd-01M50KAP8CB5MMBQE3BX4RQ2PF demonstrates an independently operated unfamiliar-study journey, both mappings, weights, readers and exact pinned Atlas readback. Preserve local/private versus public/hosted authority and explicit unavailable quantities.
4. Prospective efficacy: E1 bd-01M50KBFT26DRB77VFHPRHYNA2 freezes estimands, sample/precision, split/exposure, arms, thresholds and guards; E2 bd-01M50KC744836VNJ8F8A4AHNWH supplies independent blinded labels after actual resource approval; E3 bd-01M50KD0NHVPCEHGZND9H18M6E executes and independently reproduces a bounded positive/negative/inconclusive verdict. Reuse G3 bd-01M2TA9KKVFWPQ74HN90P0SM68, owner-resource bd-01M2TA0X79Y4BQZP0B6AT919C9 and instrument-repair bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ; do not reopen the Phase1a LLM program or treat a used holdout as untouched.

Dependency order: S1 -> U3; U1 -> U2 -> U3. Native delivery proceeds independently of S1/U1 and holds unrestricted stable Native qualification. E1 -> E2 -> E3; E2 also needs the resource decision, E3 the existing instrument repair. Research has no blocking edge into software release. Within a workstream take one bounded slice at a time; at most one helper and one heavy gate. The first executable action is S1's clean source-pin preflight; U1 and E1 design can proceed while runtime or outside resources are unavailable.

Final engineering acceptance remains on bd-01M2TAMJ95K9D7H248A8387YW4: exact reviewed candidate, scoped/full release gates as required, bound totals, clean touched tree, final extracted CLI, U3 transcript, exact producer/consumer adoption and corrected Native runtime. Record source/CLI qualification, hosted evidence, Maven deferral and any eventual tag/publication separately. Full Maven acceptance remains open while dependencies are unpublished; this plan does not close it or add scientific superiority as a shipping requirement.

Stop rules: missing source access -> repair S1; unresolved local authorization semantics -> hold U2; no accepted corrected runtime -> hold unrestricted Native release; no fresh approved data/coders -> hold E2/E3. None requires reopening completed constructors, dropping difficult units, altering sealed-test rules, guessing permission or restarting video acquisition. Existing film/organization product work retains its own release lane.

Evidence: each child requires exact SHA, input/output hashes, literal commands, actual exits and totals, discriminating controls and independent review. Historical receipts remain historical. The author/reviewer records implementation, local/hosted qualification, public delivery and empirical claims separately.
